d:
Begin your day with the timeless beauty of Morning Ragas for Positive Energy, a soulful collection of Indian classical music performed in some of the most cherished morning ragas.
Traditionally associated with sunrise and the early hours of the day, these ragas are known for creating an atmosphere of peace, clarity, and inner balance, making them ideal for meditation, yoga, relaxation, study, or a mindful start to your morning.
Credits:
Raga Ahir Bhairav - Pandit Brij Bhushan Kabra & Ustad Zakir Hussain
Raga Yamani Bilawal - Pandit Bhimsen Joshi
Raga Alhaiya Bilawal - Pandit Jasraj
